entries.question: Does Revelation say 666 itself is written on people's foreheads?
entries.short_answer: Not exactly. Revelation 13 says people receive a mark on the right hand or forehead and that the mark is connected with the beast's name or the number of its name; verse 18 identifies the number as 666. The text does not require that every forehead visibly display the digits 666.

entries.question: What appears on foreheads in Revelation?
entries.short_answer: There are rival forehead identities: God's servants are sealed on their foreheads, the 144,000 carry the Lamb/Father's name, and beast-followers receive the beast's mark on forehead or hand. Forehead therefore functions as an allegiance/identity surface in the book's symbolic world.

entries.question: What is the closest Revelation opposite to the mark of the beast?
entries.short_answer: The strongest literary counterpart is God's seal/name on the forehead: Revelation 7 seals God's servants; Revelation 14:1 places the Father/Lamb name on the 144,000; Revelation 22:4 ends with God's name on the servants' foreheads.

entries.question: Why are hand and forehead paired in Revelation's mark imagery?
entries.short_answer: The pair has biblical background in signs bound to hand and between the eyes and can be read as action plus identity/allegiance. Revelation itself does not give that abstract definition, so it remains interpretation rather than a direct gloss.

entries.question: What do buying and selling have to do with 666?
entries.short_answer: In Revelation 13 the beast-system restricts buying and selling to those bearing its mark/name/number. That makes economic participation and allegiance part of one coercive system, which is a stronger project parallel to Farm/contract/enclosure than isolated number mysticism.

entries.question: Does the Bible say a cube is 666 or the number of the beast?
entries.short_answer: No. Revelation gives the beast's number as 666 but never identifies the number with a cube. Cube=666/Beast belongs to later Timic/modern symbolic synthesis and must be labeled that way.

entries.question: When did Cube and 666 become explicit together in the Potatoverse?
entries.short_answer: An early recovered mixed cluster exists on 11 March 2026. The strongest mature user-linked anchor is 10 August 2026, when Saturnian cube, 666/number of beast, Farm, Tree of Strife, box/contract and Moon are joined as enclosure/restriction symbolism.

entries.question: When did Tim say 666 was in the forehead?
entries.short_answer: The exact earlier source has not yet been recovered. On 9 September 2026 Tim explicitly reasserted that this was part of prior material and asked the archive to recover it. The project therefore tracks it as remembered canon with an unresolved first date rather than inventing one.

entries.question: How does the Father's name on the forehead relate to 666?
entries.short_answer: Revelation sets up rival allegiance systems: the 144,000 stand with the Lamb on Zion bearing the Father/Lamb name, while the beast-system marks hand/forehead and controls commerce. Potatoverse can compare this as Source/Father identity versus proxy/enclosure identity without claiming modern people are literally those apocalyptic groups.

entries.question: Is the Saturnian Cube literally the mark of the beast?
entries.short_answer: Not biblically. In Potatoverse the Saturnian Cube can symbolize the enclosure/system in which beast-like marking, contract and access control occur. Revelation itself names no Saturnian cube.

entries.question: What does the ancient 616 variant change about 666 theories?
entries.short_answer: It shows the numerical riddle had an early textual variant. That fits name/gematria explanations better than theories requiring a timeless visual pattern of three sixes and cautions against deriving fixed cube/Saturn geometry from the written digits.

entries.question: How is the project's 2026 timeline now organized?
entries.short_answer: A new master timeline sorts dated events by date, relevance and category: identity/theology, biblical/scriptural, cube/cosmology, Farm/Strife, Dog/Mud/Footstool, North/geopolitics, karmic debt, public presence, Son/Door and research formalization. Detailed owner files keep the full evidence.
